title: Carlos Yulo places last in floor final at Worlds, shifts focus to vault

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Carlos Yulo failed to secure a medal in the floor exercise at the 2026 Artistic Gymnastics World Championships in Rotterdam, Netherlands. Yulo placed last in the apparatus final with a mark of 13.233, after falling on the mat during one of his executions. He scored 5.800 for difficulty and 7.633 in execution with a .10-point bonus, but received a 0.30-point penalty. The Filipino history-maker, who posted a 14.500 in the qualifications, won bronze in the 2025 edition of the World Championships in Jakarta. He first won gold in the event in 2019.
